name: FireConnect CLI
description: Installs the FireConnect CLI, which routes coding agents (OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, and others) through Fireworks AI models.

version.description: FireConnect version to install. 'latest' clones the default branch. Otherwise a git tag or commit SHA (for example 'v0.10.4').

login.description: If true, signs in non-interactively at build time using the FIRECONNECT_TOKEN (or FIREWORKS_API_KEY) environment variable. Keep false for personal sandboxes and sign in at runtime with 'fireconnect login' instead.
